_provenance.note: This is a deterministic, generic policy fixture for the ParcelFlow demo. It is an input an agent may reason over -- it is not itself an evaluation answer, and it does not select tests for any scenario.

ST.description: System test: run on every merge candidate, fast feedback.

SIT.description: System integration test: cross-component and cross-consumer checks.

UAT.description: User acceptance test: includes manual steps; run before release sign-off.

REGRESSION.description: Full regression sweep: run nightly and before release branch cut.

smoke-pack.description: Minimal liveness checks. Must run in every cycle regardless of detected change scope.

security-pack.description: Role-authorization and secret-handling checks. Must run whenever any API, config, or auth-related file changes.

financial-accuracy-pack.description: Monetary arithmetic checks (integer-cents correctness). Must run whenever pricing, rate-card, or currency-adjacent code changes.

deterministic_thresholds.minimum_mandatory_pack_tests_always_incl: all tests with a non-empty mandatory_pack_membership relevant to the pack(s) triggered

infeasibility_handling.rule: If the available time budget cannot accommodate all mandatory-pack tests for the applicable cycle, do not silently drop them. Flag the budget as infeasible and report which mandatory tests could not be scheduled.

approval_and_autonomy.agent_autonomy: none -- this policy is an input to human or agent reasoning about test selection; it does not grant authority to skip reviewer approval or to publish a selection as final without review.
